items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Richard Rodney Bennett and Frank Underwood sent me the lyric they said, “We need a song, Lena wants to do this lyric,” I said, “great,” and I sent him the song.

ctx.x: Yeah. Let’s see, that's all the songs I came up with, what did I miss?

Oh God, I don’t know, there’s the one Lena Horne recorded recently, “I’ll Always Leave the Door a Little Open,” in her most recent album. That happened exactly like, “I Wish I'd Met You,” Richard Rodney Bennett and Frank Underwood sent me the lyric they said, “We need a song, Lena wants to do this lyric,” I said, “great,” and I sent him the song.
